name: Get Landing Page Variables
summary: Reads the template variables (strings, colors, booleans) of a guided landing page.
whenToUse: When you want to see the values of a guided page's variables (e.g. header text, colors).

response.description: Variables defined in the template's <head> meta tags: id, value, type (string/color/boolean).

notes: Only guided (template-based) landing pages have variables — free-form pages won't return any.
